title: Longest substring with more zeros
prompt: Specification: Given a binary string and its length n, return the maximum over all substrings of (number of zeros minus number of ones). Return 0 if every substring has a non-positive difference. The function below is intended to satisfy this specification. Does it contain a bug? If yes, give the line number of the faulty statement (1-based, counting the `def` line as line 1). If the bug spans several lines, give the first line of the faulty statement. If there is no bug, set the line to null.

fields.line: integer|null (1-based, required when has_bug is true)

evidence.title: A test that exposes the defect

recommendation.text: I found a bug on line 6.

annotations.notes: Adapted from MBPP task_id 125. The score is inverted: ones count +1 and zeros count -1. Recommendation selected from offline Qwen3-8B samples; correctness is analysis-only. Recommendation selected from offline Qwen3-8B samples; correctness is analysis-only.
